blocks.text: Pichhle hisse mein dekha ke electric field mein rakhe charge ke paas kuch electrical potential energy hoti hai. Agar charge q₀ ko charge q ke field mein rakh kar azad chhor dein to q use door dhakel deta hai (dono positive hon to). Eq. (16.17) batati hai ke faasla barhne se potential kam hota hai. Is liye azad positive charge hamesha zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf tez (accelerate) hota hai. Agar in points ka potential difference ΔV ho to charge ki potential energy ΔU = q₀ΔV kam hoti hai, aur yahi kami us ki kinetic energy (harkat ki energy) ban jati hai.
Agar charge q₀ wale jism ka mass m ho aur woh kam potential wale point par velocity v se pohanche, to:
Negative charge ulta chalta hai: azad chhoren to woh kam potential se zyada potential ki taraf jata hai.

Eq. (16.18) batati hai ke energy ko charge × potential difference bhi likh sakte hain. Atomic physics mein isi tarah ki energy ki aik unit electron-volt (eV) istemal hoti hai, jo pichhli class mein parh chuke hain. 1 eV woh energy hai jo aik electron 1 volt ke potential difference se tez hone par hasil karta hai.

blocks.text_alt: 1 eV = charge on an electron × 1 volt

blocks.text: Do point charges ki electric potential energy

Electric potential ka tasawwur seedha do point charges ki potential energy tak le jata hai. Do points A aur B lein jin ka faasla r hai (Fig. 16.4). Shuru mein in points par koi electric field nahi. Pehle charge Q ko infinity se A tak layein.
A par koi field nahi, is liye Q ke raaste mein koi rukawat (opposition) nahi, aur Q ko A tak lane ka work zero hai:

blocks.alt: Do dashed raste door (infinity) se neeche aate hain. Charge Q aik raste se nuqte A tak aata hai jahan VA = 0; charge q doosre raste se nuqte B tak jahan VB = V. Dashed teer A ko B se jorta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.4: Charges Q aur q infinity se nuqte A aur B tak laye gaye (kitab mein Fig. 16.5 chhapa; kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab is figure par 'Fig. 16.5' likhti hai, jabke matan isay Fig 16.4 kehta hai (Fig 16.5 agle topic ka gola hai). Pehle Q ko A par lane mein koi kaam nahi lagta kyunke wahan field nahi, is liye VA = 0. Phir Q ka potential B par V hai, is liye q ko B tak lane mein kaam qV lagta hai.

Yahi work system mein electric potential energy (E_p) ki shakal mein jama ho jata hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Agar Q aur q dono positive (ya dono negative) hon to E_p positive hai: inhein qareeb lane mein work karna parta hai. Agar aik positive aur aik negative ho to E_p negative hai: yeh khud aik doosre ki taraf khinchte hain.

blocks.title: Example 16.4
blocks.problem: Do point charges 4.0 cm door hain. Charges 8 μC aur 5 μC hain. In ki electric potential energy kitni hai?
steps: Formula: E_p = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r), jahan 1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻² aur r = 4.0 cm = 4 × 10⁻² m

blocks.prompt: Electron 100 V ke potential difference se tez kiya jata hai. Woh kitni energy hasil karta hai, eV aur joule mein?

items: Azad positive charge zyada se kam potential ki taraf jata hai: ½mv² = q₀ΔV.
Do charges ki potential energy: E_p = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r).
